A '''Command Installation''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thule/Legends|Thule]] operated as the hub of communications for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces during the [[Battle of Thule]]. It was destroyed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] using an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]].

==Description==
The command installation is a large circular building with several corridors sprouting in all directions. It was protected by [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]] along with a complement of [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]], [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|hailfire droids]], and [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]]. The primary defenses were powered by nearby [[energy farm]]s, rendering a direct attack useless unless they were powered down.<ref name="CWPOSG">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

==History==
The installation was the primary objective of the second phase of the battle. With [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] forces successful in eliminating the [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]], Kenobi was directed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to destroy the facility in an effort to cripple Separatist communications, paving the way for an attack on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kesiak]]. After clearing a landing zone to allow two [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] to land, he appropriated a team of [[clone engineer]]s to ferry them to the first energy farm.<ref name="Clone Wars" />

After having cleared a second landing zone, Kenobi provided cover fire for the now-disembarked [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] as [[Ground Armored Tank]]s bore down on their position from nearby [[Thule droid factory/Legends|factories]], all the while shooting down waves of droid starfighters. With the internal shields disabled, Kenobi dispatched the first energy farm with a volley of laser fire, [[Missile/Legends|missiles]], and concentrations of [[composite-beam laser]]s.<ref name="Clone Wars" />

With the area secured by the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], Kenobi returned to pick up a second group of engineers and proceeded to the second and final energy farm sustaining the command installation, this time fighting increased resistance from [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]] entering the fray. With the final farm neutralized, Kenobi took a run on the installation, focusing on eight couplings protruding from the building. With all couplings destroyed, the command installation succumbed to massive power losses and internal explosions, completing phase two of the mission.<ref name="CWPOSG" />
